entry.name: bline
entry.description: Generates a linear ramp driven by incoming bang messages. It takes a list of breakpoint segments (and the number of events to span) and outputs a smooth ramp between values.

arguments.name: initial-value

messages.name: bang
messages.description: Sends a new step in the breakpoint list out the left outlet. If the current list of ramp segments is finished, amessage will be sent out the right outlet

messages.name: float
messages.description: Sets theobject to the specified float value. Any and all pending breakpoint segments are forgotten (i.e. the time is considered 0 andoutputs the target value when it receives a).

messages.name: int
messages.description: Sets theobject to the specified integer value. Any and all pending breakpoint segments are forgotten (i.e. the time is considered 0 andoutputs the target value when it receives a).

messages.name: list
messages.digest: Set segment values and event counts
messages.description: Theobject sets breakpoint segment values using lists of data composed of pairs of numbers. The first number in each pair can be either an int or a float specifying a target value, followed by an integer that specifies the number ofmessages that will have to be received before reaching the target value--note that this differs from other Max breakpoint objects like, which specify a time-to-target value in milliseconds.

messages.name: set
messages.description: Sets theobject to the specified value. Any and all pending breakpoint segments are forgotten (i.e. the time is considered 0 andoutputs the target value when it receives a).

messages.name: stop
messages.description: Stopsfrom sending out numbers, until a new list of ramp segments is received.
